notes: Official Knot portrait is front-facing and is composited on the right, matching the approved meadow pattern. The left side is reserved for a code-drawn hero (soft ground spot only). No friend characters are painted in. The background was rebuilt from the official woods scene renderer (background only): complete pretzel-gate and clearing, with no friend and no baked-in boss. Official front-facing Knot is composited on top at the locked-scene feet position, using a contact-shadow-only cutout so the ink smile stays opaque. Anchor is the feet-center / ground contact. bbox is [x, y, w, h] in pixels of that orientation's faceoff image.
